channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Indian, German firms to collaborate on immunoglobulin products: Indian Embassy
item.description: The Indian mission facilitated the exchange of a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) between Germany's Neovii Biotech GmbH and India's VINS Bioproducts Ltd. on the sidelines of the Indo-German Health Leadership Dialogue on October 13, says Embassy of India in Berlin

item.title: CJP Tiranga protest LIVE | Massive security for CJP’s ‘Tiranga’ march; SC refuses urgent hearing on Central Park closure
item.description: The Committee to Protect Journalists said police in Delhi, Ahmedabad, Pune and Mumbai detained journalists even after the Supreme Court secured assurances from the Solicitor-General that press and lawyers would not be impeded

item.title: Sanjay Raut has to explain his conduct, says SC while hearing plea over SIR
item.description: Sanjay Raut is one of the co-petitioners among the 13 petitioners in the plea filed by Rahul Gandhi

item.title: 150 pairs of buffalos to leave Puttur on October 17 for Mysuru Dasara kambala
item.description: Owners of 172 pairs of buffalos had applied to participate in the event

item.title: Congress, allies seeking Bangladesh-like regime change: Rajnath
item.description: Addressing a press conference in Lucknow, Mr. Singh asserted that democracy does not give anyone the licence to create disorder or undermine the credibility of constitutional institutions

item.title: Pinarayi Vijayan moves SC against HC order to lodge FIR in CMRL bribery case
item.description: Sidharth Luthra, appearing for Mr. Vijayan, mentioned the plea for urgent listing before a Bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi, saying an FIR has been registered in the case

item.title: Lycee kicks off bicentenary celebrations in Puducherry
Home Ministry moves out 3 of 5 officers from division hit by bribery allegations
item.description: Action comes days after two government officials were apprehended by the Delhi Police for allegedly seeking bribes to process registrations under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act

item.title: 1980 murder case: Allahabad HC finds two convicts were minors, remits matter to Juvenile Justice Board
item.description: A Division Bench of Justices Abdul Moin and Pramod Kumar Srivastava on Thursday (October 15, 2026) passed the order on an appeal arising from the incident that took place in Sultanpur on September 28, 1980.

item.title: Security forces, police launch multiple search operations in J&K’s Poonch
item.description: The operations are aimed at strengthening security and checking possible terrorist movement in the border district, officials said.

item.title: Nandigram police station officer in-charge replaced day before bypoll
item.description: The replacement came after Opposition parties complained to the Election Commission, alleging that Mishra was close to the ruling party. Mishra had been posted as the IC of Nandigram police station ahead of the 2026 Assembly elections

item.title: Sanjaynagar Main Road work near completion, footpath woes persist for Bengaluru residents
item.description: The work is scheduled to be completed by November-end, according to sources in the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA)

item.title: Start-ups, investors, industry to meet at IIT Palakkad innovation summit
item.description: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan will inaugurate the meet named SAMAGRA 2.0: IIT Palakkad Innovation Summit 2026 to be held at Hyatt Regency on October 29 and 30

item.title: Sanjay Raut, Dipke demand removal of MPSC chairman
item.description: “Thousands of students from different parts of Maharashtra have been taking to the streets and are even prepared to face arrest to press for their demands linked to the Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC),” says Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut

item.title: Aaditya Thackeray to join Pune MPSC protest, backs demand for chairperson’s exit
item.description: “I have just spoken to Vivekanand Patil. October 6, I will go and sit with the students participating in the MPSC agitation in Pune,” Aaditya Thackeray

item.title: TDP, YSRCP activists clash in Punganur on first day of nominations; MP Midhun Reddy’s convoy attacked
item.description: Activists of both parties are injured in stone pelting and at least four cars are vandalised

item.title: SI suspended for pointing pistol at flood victims during distribution of relief materials in Bihar’s Saran
item.description: The State government has also suspended seven engineers and initiated departmental proceedings against another official for alleged negligence in handling the floods after heavy rainfall in Nepal’s catchment areas raised water levels in Gandak river

item.title: Nation, Parliament must debate political appeals to children during elections: Madras High Court
item.description: Justice D. Bharatha Chakravarthy says YouTube reels made by parents showing their children pestering them to vote for TVK during the 2026 elections were in bad taste and reflected poor parenting

item.title: Omar Abdullah writes to J&K chief secretary over IAS officer’s ‘misbehaviour’, says NC MLA Tanvir Sadiq
item.description: Tanvir Sadiq said if J&K had been a full State, IAS officer Kumar Rajiv Ranjan, accused of using abusive language against an officer in an official meeting, “would have been attached to the General Administration Department (GAD) pending a formal inquiry into his conduct”.

item.title: Air India extends cancellation of Saudi Arabia flights till October 20
item.description: Passengers affected by the cancellations are being offered a full refund, the airline said
